name: Hinder Natural Attack (Combat)
body:
You hamper an opponent’s ability to use one of its natural attacks.

Prerequisite: Int 13, Str 13, Combat Expertise, Improved Sunder, Power Attack, base attack bonus +11

Benefit: Select one of your opponent’s natural weapons. If you make a successful combat maneuver check, your opponent cannot use that natural attack for 1d4 rounds.

Special: With the GM’s permission you can attempt this maneuver without the use of this feat at a -20 penalty, and provoke an attack of opportunity; if you are hit by this attack, the maneuver fails.
